content:
name: Temporary CR-0002 registration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - governance/cr-0002-registration
    paths:
      - .eos/cr-0002-registration-trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  register:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Remove temporary controls before governed operations
        run: |
          rm .github/workflows/temporary-cr-0002-registration.yml
          rm .eos/cr-0002-registration-trigger

      - name: Register and approve CR-0002 through EOS
        env:
          EOS_ACTOR: Project Authority
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cp engineering/changes/CR-0002.md /tmp/CR-0002-detailed.md
          rm engineering/changes/CR-0002.md
          ./scripts/eos change create product/product-requirements.md "Expand Monad capability and roadmap baseline"
          ./scripts/eos change approve CR-0002 --by "Project Authority" --reason "Approve the expanded Monad capability and roadmap baseline directed by Project Authority"
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          generated = Path('engineering/changes/CR-0002.md')
          detailed = Path('/tmp/CR-0002-detailed.md')
          text = generated.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          if not text.startswith('---\n'):
              raise SystemExit('generated CR-0002 is missing EOS front matter')
          end = text.find('\n---\n', 4)
          if end < 0:
              raise SystemExit('generated CR-0002 front matter is malformed')
          front_matter = text[: end + len('\n---\n')]
          body = detailed.read_text(encoding='utf-8').lstrip()
          generated.write_text(front_matter + '\n' + body, encoding='utf-8')
          PY

      - name: Refresh current Work Packet evidence for final source fingerprint
        env:
          EOS_ACTOR: github-actions[bot]
        run: |
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0003 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0004 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0009

      - name: Regenerate deterministic projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Verify governed repository state
        run: |
          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Commit governed CR registration and refreshed projections
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          git diff --cached --quiet --exit-code && exit 0
          git commit -m "docs(governance): register and approve CR-0002"
          git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
